title: Jamie Foxx and Affion Crockett: Unfiltered on Def Comedy Jam
description:
Before the Oscar. Before the Grammy. Before Ray, before Django, before Jamie Foxx became one of the most decorated entertainers alive — he was right here on Def Comedy Jam, hosting the show and absolutely stealing it.

Foxx opens with Africa, OJ, and why white people at a Black comedy show deserve their own round of applause for bravery. He breaks down the exact science of getting a woman back to the hotel room step by step — and the whole room loses it. Affion Crockett dreams of joyriding with Beavis and Butt-Head, gets pulled over by Bernie Mac, and nearly gets burned alive by his cellmate — all in one night. Corey Holcomb goes in on the nastiest house you've ever been to, every man's secret side relationship with his hand, and a Baptist preacher whose entire sermon is about baby mamas. Barbara Carlyle closes with a medical diagnosis nobody saw coming. Kid Capri on the decks. Russell Simmons closes the show.

This is Russell Simmons' Def Comedy Jam. Episodes every Monday and Wednesday on @LOLStandup & every Friday on @LOLNetwork.
